description: Source code for the AutoBackendTexture class, which manages GPU textures backed by Android hardware buffers, including creation, reference management, and integration with Skia rendering.

classes.name: AutoBackendTexture
classes.description: Manages a GPU backend texture created from an Android hardware buffer, providing methods for creating images and surfaces for rendering.

methods.name: AutoBackendTexture
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the backend texture from an Android hardware buffer.

methods.name: ~AutoBackendTexture
methods.description: Destructor that releases the backend texture resources.

methods.name: unref
methods.description: Decrements usage count and adds to cleanup manager if no longer in use.

methods.name: releaseSurfaceProc
methods.description: Callback invoked when SkSurface is no longer using the texture.

methods.name: releaseImageProc
methods.description: Callback invoked when SkImage is no longer using the texture.

methods.name: logFatalTexture
methods.description: Logs detailed info and aborts if texture creation or usage fails.

methods.name: makeImage
methods.description: Creates an SkImage from the backend texture with specified color space and alpha type.

methods.name: getOrCreateSurface
methods.description: Creates or retrieves an SkSurface for rendering to the backend texture.
